prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE wide 16:9 pixel art gameplay style frame for Selantis, battle fever dream, color dramaturgy test. Reference image is ONLY for style: match its elevated overhead oblique RPG camera, small proportionate characters, crisp uniform pixel clusters, dense painterly pixel environments, spare tiny HUD. Replace all reference scenery and characters.
Composition: shoulder of a sloping battlefield, trampled muddy olive grass and steel grey rocks, smoke occluding the valley, extremely dim flat grey daylight becoming night. In the lower distant valley a vast black army is a mass of tiny human silhouettes; behind Valentus at the top a few allied ranks and completely unmarked plain banners. A clearly readable scene in the foreground: Valentus left of center, old gaunt upright man with shoulder-length grey hair, blue-and-white flowing cloth robe whipping in wind, raises one EMPTY hand toward an axe fighter. NO staff, NO armor. Axe fighter to right stands with axe raised directly over a young fallen soldier age 16–17, hands shielding his face. Make the boy recognizably prone, vulnerable and unarmored at the head. Put ONE simple small axe intent icon above the axe fighter and ONE red target tile outline beneath the boy; subtle local tactical tile traces, not a giant luminous grid. Valentus's robe blue #397FC1 is the only saturated cool color, quiet orange embers/fires far below, all other colors steel grey, near black, mud olive, smoke. Tiny upper left HUD: old grey-haired Valentus portrait and single full health bar, at bottom only two ability icons; no other words or labels. Figurines occupy about 8 percent of image height and are fully visible, environments dominate. High angle like reference, not a cinematic side view. Sharply pixelated without smoothing or neon bloom. No castle, ruins, runes, coats of arms, extra magical weapons, youthful mage, cartoon proportions, green spring meadow. Output only the composed battle frame.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine this exact Selantis battle pixel-art frame, preserving the muddy steel-grey olive battlefield, smoke, embers in valley, black human armies, elevated overhead oblique RPG perspective, HUD restraint, intent axe icon, red target under boy, and exact story situation. Two targeted changes: (1) ALL allied banners and all allied uniforms become desaturated steel grey and muddy charcoal, with completely plain unmarked flags. Valentus's saturated blue robe must be the ONLY saturated cool blue anywhere in scene. (2) Reduce foreground character sprite sizes, especially Valentus, axe fighter and fallen boy, to small gameplay sprites around 10–12 percent of total picture height rather than heroic foreground figures; preserve their readable positions and pose, reconstruct their surrounding muddy ground accordingly. Old gaunt upright Valentus with shoulder-length grey hair raises empty hand, blue-white cloth robe, no armor/staff. Axe fighter stands over prone 16–17 boy who shields face with BOTH hands. No castle or buildings in distant valley: smoke, faint orange embers and black army silhouette masses only. Keep crisp uniform pixel-art style and all other existing composition. Output ONE wide 16:9 image.
frames.delivery: Generated original, copied into workspace; not a production sprite atlas or normalized background.

prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE wide 16:9 pixel art gameplay style frame for Selantis, refuge cradle, color dramaturgy test. Reference image ONLY establishes pixel style and camera: same elevated overhead oblique top-down RPG view, small anatomically proportionate figures in a wide environmental room, crisp coherent pixel clusters, restrained HUD. Replace all reference scene, vegetation and people.
Scene: modest wooden room at night, dark wood brown #392A23. ONE small candle is the only warm light source, quiet amber #D89B4B. No fireplace or other lamps, no moonbeam. Wooden walls with shelves of pottery vessels. A bed on one side and a wooden door at the foot of the bed, a cradle in the opposite corner. Wide high camera, entire room visible, no close-up. TWO equally wrapped sleeping newborn infants lie side by side in the same cradle, identically covered and equally visible. Their appearance does not identify a chosen child.
Valentus: OLD, gaunt exhausted man, shoulder-length grey hair, soft blue and white cloth clothing, NO cloak, NO staff or armor. Clearly visible thick cloth bandage wrapped around abdomen beneath ribs. His RIGHT hand is pressed to his wounded right side. His body leans physically against the cradle rim for support, while his OTHER (left) hand raises just above the exact center of the cradle, midway between the infants. Pose must read as weight supported by the rim, weary stoop, not standing comfortably. A very weak small blue #397FC1 shimmer around the raised left hand, not a big magic cloud, does not single out either infant. Keep BOTH infants distinct and countable. Candle gives first safe warm refuge, huge dark areas surrounding one amber light pool. Small figure around 10 percent of image height; environment dominates. At most ONE tiny understated Q hand-interaction icon in bottom center, no portrait panels, health bars or labels in this quiet scene. Palette dark wood, amber, dull white cloth, weak blue. Actual hard-edged pixel art, no photographic textures, soft lens blur or neon glow. No added people or decorative symbols.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine this exact pixel art refuge room. Preserve room composition, one amber candle as only warm light, bed, door at foot of bed, dark wooden shelves with pottery, TWO identically wrapped sleeping infants in one corner cradle, weak blue shimmer centered between them, empty room except Valentus and infants, tiny Q icon and uniformly crisp pixel style. Correct figure scale and posture: make Valentus and the cradle substantially smaller gameplay-scale objects in the room, so the full standing equivalent height of Valentus is around 12–14 percent of total image height, matching the small characters of an elevated top-down RPG. Enlarge the surrounding visible wooden floor naturally. Valentus is OLD, particularly GAUNT and slender, exhausted, shoulder-length grey hair; wears blue-white soft cloth with NO cloak and NO armor. Make the thick white abdominal BANDAGE clearly visible across his midriff under the ribs. His RIGHT hand presses the wounded right side, his body leans against the cradle edge for physical support, and LEFT hand is lifted with a small weak blue shimmer above the midpoint between the infants. Both babies remain equally visible, equal size, equally wrapped, unidentifiable. Preserve the dim intimate dark brown and amber lighting, no added objects or lamps. Keep elevated overhead view, no dramatic portrait or close-up. Output one wide 16:9 image.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a single placement correction to this exact Selantis pixel-art refuge frame: the cradle and Valentus must be IN A CORNER of the room, close against wooden walls, rather than in the open middle of the floor. Move them as one small gameplay-scale group to the right-hand corner near the pottery shelves; adjust the nearby chest/floor only as needed to create a clear corner nook against the walls. Keep the same elevated overhead camera, the room's wide framing, the bed and door at its foot, one amber candle as the only warm light, all other furniture and dark palette. Valentus remains old, gaunt, with shoulder-length GREY hair lit amber at edges, NO cloak, visible abdominal bandage. RIGHT hand stays pressed to wounded right side; he leans against the cradle rim, LEFT hand raised with very weak blue shimmer exactly over center between TWO equally visible identically wrapped sleeping infants. Keep these pose and counting details unchanged. Keep small sprites and tiny Q icon. No new people, no additional light sources, no portrait panels. Output ONE wide pixel-art frame.
